0022600185.text: The Sacramento Kings (1-6, 0-2 at home) host the Los Angeles Lakers (6-2, on a two-game winning streak) in Sacramento's eighth game of the 2026-27 season, with the Kings 15th in the West and 4.5 games behind the Lakers' division leaders in the Pacific. Ben Simmons (Achilles surgery), Keegan Murray (ankle), and Maxime Raynaud (dislocated knee) are out for Sacramento, Precious Achiuwa is day-to-day with ankle soreness and a game-time decision, and Adou Thiero (knee inflammation) is out for Los Angeles. The teams have not met yet this season, and the Kings lost the 2025-26 season series 1-3, including a 128-104 defeat in Los Angeles on March 1, 2026.
